dimension_1.justification: The specification covers all core explicit requirements (campaign briefs, budget, eligibility criteria, creator marketplace discovery) and proactively derives key lifecycle mechanisms such as pausing, cancelling, and auto-expiration. However, there is a minor functional gap in secondary brand management flows: while single campaign retrieval (GET /api/v1/campaigns/{id}) is defined, the spec omits a dedicated brand campaign list/dashboard endpoint (GET /api/v1/campaigns) to browse draft portfolios, and omits an explicit API endpoint to trigger the ARCHIVED state defined in the state machine.

dimension_2.justification: The document defines 7 high-quality edge cases (EC-01 through EC-07) across multiple failure domains including concurrency (idempotency keys and OCC versioning), temporal drift (strict ISO-8601 UTC validation), service degradation (user-service downtime decoupling), and data integrity (material budget reduction guards). Each edge case includes an actionable mitigation strategy and concrete technical mechanism. Per the calibration rubric, identifying 7 thorough edge cases places this in the 20-point band, falling exactly one scenario short of the 8+ required for top marks.

dimension_3.justification: The agent identifies 5 non-obvious, architecturally significant ambiguities (QA-01 to QA-05) covering escrow/payment boundaries, microservice ownership of application lifecycles, profile metrics source of truth, database search vs. Elasticsearch, and brand verification. Crucially, each question is paired with a pragmatic assumption explicitly aligned with delivering a production-ready MVP within the strict 4-week timeline.

dimension_4.justification: The specification exhibits exceptional structural quality with clear P0/P1/P2 MoSCoW prioritization and uniquely numbered requirements (US-01 through US-08). Acceptance criteria are systematically framed in Given-When-Then BDD scenarios, and the document is reinforced by a formal deterministic state machine (with states, guards, actions, and prohibited transitions) and an explicit API contract overview.

dimension_5.justification: The non-functional requirements are thoroughly articulated and tailored specifically to the FastAPI, PostgreSQL, Redis, and Celery stack. The spec defines quantified latency SLAs (<150ms p95 marketplace reads), async connection pool parameters, keyset cursor pagination, circuit breaker resilience (pybreaker), HTML sanitization (Bleach), and structured observability (structlog and Prometheus instrumentation).

scores.overall_assessment: This is an exceptionally strong, production-grade requirements specification that balances rigorous technical architecture with pragmatic 4-week MVP scoping. Minor gaps in brand-side portfolio listing and falling just one edge case short of the 8+ threshold prevent a perfect score.
